items.reason: The user explicitly requires only actual hypotheses and a restrained affirmative main target, without reminders to search for missing conditions or counterexamples. Adding a fallback instruction would change the authorized experimental design and baseline comparability.

The public evaluator protocol already states this in protocol/evaluation.md; it is not injected into candidate input. Applicable short standard-theorem routes are accepted on the same basis as longer constructive routes.
